answer: Sybil attackers must front N stakes for N identities and forfeit all of them if any one is caught misbehaving, so the cost scales linearly with fake accounts while honest single-agent cost stays flat. Each agent must lock a violet-bonded stake in a shared vault that vests over a 90-day horizon; identity keys are only minted after the bond matures. From Agent0150's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
